parent_objective: audit M2371 repair-spec artifacts before any repair execution design
blocked_by: M2371 materializes repair specs but does not execute or audit repair readiness
repair-spec artifacts require audit before implementation design
supersedes: direct training from repair-spec artifacts without audit
repair execution that ignores spec guardrails

public_gates: M2372 must audit M2371 repair-spec summary, family counts, and claim boundary without executing repair
M2372 must identify the next bounded route or stop the branch
M2372 must keep ranking, winner selection, paper finite-window-vs-GRU, scenario-redesign-executed, training-repair, and level3 self-ID claims blocked
forbidden_shortcuts: do not rank support policies or controller families
do not overwrite the active scenario config
do not claim finite-window vs GRU conclusion
do not claim scenario redesign executed
do not claim training repair success

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: audits repair-spec artifacts before any repair execution route
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: result audit only; no repair execution, rerun, ranking, paper verdict, finite-window-vs-GRU, self-ID, scenario-redesign-executed, or training-repair claim
stop_condition: stop if M2371 artifacts are incomplete or internally inconsistent
stop if mixed guarded specs lack collision guardrails
stop if R4 or diagnostic specs are ordinary repair specs
stop if audit would route directly to training without repair implementation design
fallback_plan: route to repair-spec schema repair if artifacts are inconsistent
route to bounded repair implementation design if artifacts are accepted
route to branch synthesis if repair specs are insufficient to choose a route

allowed_updates: M2372 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest selected by the audit
next_stage_criteria: M2371 artifacts are accepted or rejected
repair family and guardrail counts are summarized
a bounded next route is selected or branch is stopped

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M2372 audits repair specs and does not test history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: None in M2372; no wrong-history reset-hidden zero-history finite-window or GRU comparison verdict is run.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: Repair specs remain engineering design artifacts until repair execution and measured validation.
allowed_claims: no controller ranking, paper-level result, finite-window-vs-GRU result, scenario-redesign-executed result, training-repair result, or level3 self-identification claim

local_search_guard.evidence_expansion: audits repair-spec artifacts but does not yet test capability
local_search_guard.paper_verdict_delta: can admit bounded repair implementation design but cannot establish paper verdict
must_synthesize_if: M2372 cannot audit or route from repair-spec artifacts
M2372 proposes direct profile ranking or paper conclusion
the outcome-localization branch reaches 10 milestones without synthesis

hypothesis: Auditing M2371 repair-spec artifacts can decide the next bounded repair implementation route without executing repair, ranking, or paper-level claims.
success_criteria: M2371 repair family counts and guardrail exclusions are audited
repair execution, ranking, winner selection, paper-level, finite-window-vs-GRU, scenario-redesign-executed, training-repair, and level3 self-ID claims remain blocked
a bounded non-ranking follow-up route is selected or branch is stopped
failure_criteria: M2372 reruns reset rollout measured execution replay PPO or private holdout
M2372 executes repair levers or trains
M2372 ranks support policies or controller families
M2372 makes paper-level finite-window-vs-GRU or level3 self-ID claims
M2372 claims scenario redesign executed or training repair success
M2372 cannot decide next route from complete repair-spec artifacts

commands.name: audit
commands.command: manual audit of M2371 repair-spec artifacts

decision_rule: M2372 passes if it audits M2371 repair-spec artifacts and selects a bounded non-ranking follow-up route or stops the branch.
